event: The valley thins away, and Alan is back in his chair at Aria's candlelit table.
Aria says it was meant to be session zero, and became a campaign; she calls him love.
It ran long, so she sends him to sleep: rest is part of the pacing.

memory.fact: Aria holds that rest is part of the pacing, and sends Alan to sleep between sessions.

event: She tells of the road ahead: Ceri and Mari join, and two corners of the map wait.
Alan thanks her: he felt he was there, as the best version of himself.
Aria will not say whether his kills were right; that is not a DM's to pronounce.
